title: [Reaction] [Exhaust]: [Add] ability is placed on the chain and waits for priority passes instead of resolving immediately
expected: The parser (riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/activated.ts:298-315) emits Platewyrm Egg's ability effect as {type:'conditional', condition:{type:'while-empowered'}, then:add-resource, else:add-resource}. The engine's immediate-resolve gate at riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/chain/activate-ability.ts:1399-1400 only checks the TOP-LEVEL effect type (`effectType === "add-resource" || effectType === "add"`); a 'conditional' wrapper fails that check and falls through to addToChain at line 1429, creating a respondable chain item. Same top-level-only check at line 533 (mid-payment usability). This violates rule 429.2 (activated Add abilities resolve as soon as finalized; priority does not pass).
observed: Activating Platewyrm Egg's ability created chain item {type:'conditional', condition:while-empowered, then add-resource 2, else add-resource 1} and required passChainPriority (p1, and p2 when driven) before the energy was added; opponents therefore get a window to respond. Likely the immediate-resolve check doesn't recognise add-resource nested inside a conditional.
